DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS = '2023-09-01';

TRUNCATE TABLE D360.SYN_STG_CORE_ACCTAUTHSIGN;

INSERT INTO D360.SYN_STG_CORE_ACCTAUTHSIGN--SYN.STG_CORE_ACCTAUTHSIGN
select 
 ACID
,BANK_ID
,CUST_ID
,ACCT_POA_AS_REC_TYPE
,ENTITY_CRE_FLG
,DEL_FLG
,ACCT_POA_AS_SRL_NUM
,BNK_CODE BANK_CODE
,'CORE' SOURCE_CODE
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS DATETIME) AS insert_dttm
from EDS.DEP_ACCOUNTRELATIONSHIP AAS WHERE AS_OF_DATE =  @DATETOPROCESS;
